prompt:
A single small creature painted BY HAND on a wood panel, matte paint with visible brush texture and faint wood grain, pale bone-grey painted background with generous empty space around it. FLAT painting — no 3D shading, no drop shadow, no gloss, no gradients, no vector-sharp edges.
EXACT PROPORTIONS: the figure is SLIGHTLY TALLER THAN WIDE. The head is only about 40 percent of total height and is NOT oversized. The body is a soft PEAR shape that WIDENS TOWARD THE BASE so THE WEIGHT SITS LOW and it reads as planted and solid. Head merges into body with no neck. Two SMALL ROUND EARS on top, each only about one fifth the width of the head. The face carries ONLY two SMALL GLOWING GREEN DOT EYES set wide apart and high — NO nose, NO muzzle, NO mouth, NO whiskers, no other marking. Three small green tally marks on the chest. Arms are tiny nubs barely separated from the body, hanging at its sides; feet are tiny and short so the body almost reaches the ground. Solid black body with a thin soft darker outline.
NOT chibi, NOT big-headed, NOT squat. Cute through weight and stance. Standing facing forward, calm. No text, no lettering.
policy: internal concept art only — never the shipped public face
